parameters.query: SELECT t.id, t.code, t.name, t.sport, (t.organizer_user_id = viewer.id) AS is_owner, (t.fixtures_published_at IS NOT NULL) AS published, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('id', d.id, 'name', d.name, 'sort_order', d.sort_order)) FROM tournament_divisions d WHERE d.tournament_id = t.id) AS divisions, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('division_id', m.division_id, 'status', m.status, 'innings', JSON_EXTRACT(m.live, '$.innings')))  FROM tournament_matches m WHERE m.tournament_id = t.id AND m.status IN ('LIVE', 'COMPLETED') AND m.live IS NOT NULL) AS matches, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('entry_id', e.id, 'name', tm.name, 'short', tm.short_name, 'logo_key', tm.logo_key))  FROM tournament_entries e JOIN teams tm ON tm.id = e.team_id WHERE e.tournament_id = t.id AND e.status = 'APPROVED') AS teams, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(e.id) FROM tournament_entries e WHERE e.tournament_id = t.id AND e.status = 'APPROVED' AND (  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tournament_entry_players ep WHERE ep.entry_id = e.id AND ep.user_id = viewer.id) OR   EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM team_members mm WHERE mm.team_id = e.team_id AND mm.user_id = viewer.id AND mm.status = 'ACTIVE'))) AS my_entries FROM tournaments t LEFT JOIN app_users viewer ON viewer.phone = $1 WHERE t.code = $2 AND t.status <> 'DRAFT'
